reason: This plugin is primarily a local context utility for DeepSeek Harness users: it adds a context badge in the DSH composer, keeps per-session/workspace notes and todos, and provides optional macOS foreground-window context tracking. The evidence indicates a DSH web plugin with local persistence and an optional local macOS companion, which supports memory/context management rather than model control, code generation, or external service orchestration.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供本地化上下文管理体验，包括会话/工作区的上下文徽标、笔记与待办记录，并可选配 macOS 前台窗口伴随程序。
summaries.en: This plugin provides local context management for DeepSeek Harness with a composer badge, per-session workspace notes and todos, plus an optional macOS companion for foreground window context tracking.

capabilities: Stores per-session and per-workspace notes/todos in browser localStorage.
Displays session context information such as session/workspace identifiers and progress metrics in a DSH dock badge.
Optionally tracks macOS foreground application/window title and keeps recent foreground contexts locally.
Shows and reopens recent contexts through a companion interface.

reasons.code: Local notes/todos and session/workspace context are explicitly persisted with local-first storage and no remote sync described.
Plugin manifests declare web client injection for DSH and optional macOS companion scripts/build flow, confirming cross-surface behavior.
Repository metadata and files include macOS companion implementation artifacts and plugin patch configuration for DSH integration.
